Stars with `entry` are lit (written log entries); stars with `url` are shelved work, frozen but live at their URLs (re-linking them here was Dave's explicit 2026-08-15 reversal of the reset's no-re-link clause); stars with neither are declared-but-unwritten — the to-do list. Eras are the four-decade spine. Validated + counted by scripts/sky-census.js at pre-deploy; rendered at /sky. This file is public in the repo — private topics stay out.

stars.title: The staple test
stars.note: Cars, silly experiments, cause and effect by hand. Measured my reaction time against a stapler — too slow, hospital, staple removed, curiosity kept. Hands-on doer, literally.

stars.title: Mario in an analog house
stars.note: An old Nintendo as the one screen worth tinkering with, in a world that was otherwise all analog.

stars.title: Disconnected: Warcraft on dial-up
stars.note: 1995. Parents call the house mid-game and the line drops. The internet as a thing you could lose to a phone call.

stars.title: Low ping on Singtel Magix
stars.note: Secondary school, Counter-Strike, an unfair advantage measured in milliseconds. The uncommoditized, heterogeneous, wild-west internet — the good old days.

stars.title: First HTML, and the relics
stars.note: Clunky websites, writing HTML thinking 'what the heck is this'. Blogs were the rage — Blogspot; relics now: Yahoo, Altavista, Netscape. What lasted built a moat.

stars.title: Learning to search, learning to prompt
stars.note: Discovering Google Earth and Maps; realising most people never learned how to wield information. The same skill each era: how do you prompt, what is context, do you know LLMs are probabilistic? Knowing how an era begins — jump in with two feet, two hands, and try things.
